title: Route rewritten twice, address unreachable
body: The newspaper’s delivery route is logged under a program number, rewritten twice in one week; the receipt behind it renews a subscription to an address marked temporarily unreachable. Someone has pencilled save the puzzles in the margin.
rival_reading: A field program relocating its own staff could just as easily leave a rerouted subscription and an unreachable address; a rewritten route number does not by itself show an evacuation order.
gloss: A rewritten delivery route and a subscription renewal both name an address as temporarily unreachable.

title: The order predates the notice by two days
body: The notebook’s last field entry logs a treatment order under a shift number the postmaster’s board doesn’t list until two days later. A postcard from that week was stamped but never collected; the back has only a ballgame score.
rival_reading: A containment response could log its own treatment order under the same shift numbering before the postmaster's board caught up; a two-day gap between a field entry and the board does not by itself point to agriculture.
gloss: A field-logged treatment order is entered under a shift number the postmaster’s board does not list until two days later.
